warmup: mise exec node@24.22.1 -- npm install --global node-gyp@11.5.0
mise exec node@24.22.1 -- corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
install: mise exec node@24.22.1 -- corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

db.cmd: docker start -a dokploy-postgres || docker run --name dokploy-postgres -p 5432:5432 -e POSTGRES_USER=dokploy -e POSTGRES_DB=dokploy -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=amukds4wi9001583845717ad2 -v dokploy-postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:16

web.cmd: pnpm --filter=./apps/dokploy run migration:run && exec pnpm run dokploy:dev

apps.cmd: if [ "$(docker info --format '{{.Swarm.LocalNodeState}}')" != active ]; then docker swarm init --advertise-addr "$(hostname -I | cut -d' ' -f1)"; fi && cd apps/dokploy && pnpm exec tsx -r dotenv/config -e '(async()=>{const s=await import("@dokploy/server/setup/setup");const t=await import("@dokploy/server/setup/traefik-setup");const c=await import("@dokploy/server/setup/config-paths");c.setupDirectories();await s.initializeNetwork();t.createDefaultMiddlewares();t.createDefaultTraefikConfig();await t.initializeStandaloneTraefik();process.exit(0)})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})' && exec docker logs --follow dokploy-traefik
